title: Paradise X #1 #3 Lot Marvel 2002 Alex Ross Covers Jim Krueger Earth X
condition_description: Both bright and clean with light handling wear. See photos.
description:
Paradise X #1 and #3 (2002), Marvel Comics - the third chapter of the Earth X trilogy after Earth X and Universe X. Painted Alex Ross covers; Jim Krueger with Alex Ross, art by Doug Braithwaite and Bill Reinhold. Direct editions, $2.99 cover price each.

- #1: back cover got chocolate milk? Mat Hoffman BMX ad
- #3: back cover 100 Day Marvel Gift Pack Giveaway (Spider-Man) ad

Condition: both bright and clean with light handling wear (see photos).

Ships bagged in a protective mailer.
